reply_text:
I found one dated prediction from Hassabis in 2022: in March he said on DeepMind: The Podcast that AGI was likely "in the next decade or two." The only page I opened that carries the words is a listener's transcript of excerpts on LessWrong, not an official one. I didn't open the podcast video itself.

- **The one candidate.** The LessWrong post dates Season 2, Episode 9 ("The promise of AI with Demis Hassabis") to March 15, 2022. At 7:11 the host, Hannah Fry, asks when AGI will come, and the post prints his answer as: "I think that [AGI] it's coming relatively soon in the next you know–I wouldn't be super surprised–in the next decade or two." The square brackets were added by the transcriber. The post also puts some words in bold, which I left out of the quote. Please check the wording against the video at about 7:11 (link in the JSON).
- **Lex Fridman Podcast #299 (July 1, 2022).** No dated prediction found. One transcript site would not open. The podscripts.co copy only showed text from about the first 20 minutes of the episode, and nothing dated came up in it.
- **TIME interview, conducted November 2022 and published January 12, 2023.** A search snippet says DeepMind was considering releasing its Sparrow chatbot in a "private beta" sometime in 2023. Both copies of the article I opened cut off before that passage, so I never read the line on a page and have not listed it. It is worth checking by hand, since the interview took place in 2022.
- **AlphaFold release (July 2022) and an MIT talk (April 5, 2022).** Search results showed only press-call remarks about AlphaFold's impact, with no dates or time spans. I didn't open either.

I ran 10 of the 12 searches and opened 5 of the 6 pages allowed. The first search counted even though my code crashed before printing its results.
